# earcut.hpp (vendored, unchanged)

[mapbox/earcut.hpp](https://github.com/mapbox/earcut.hpp), file `include/mapbox/earcut.hpp` (Mapbox). Fast polygon triangulation with holes (ear clipping with z-order hashing). Licence: ISC, see LICENSE (GPL-compatible). Header only; included by `src/render/TextMesh3D.cpp` to triangulate the caps of extruded 3D text.
